breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes both σ_avg and τ_avg in the maximum in-plane shear stress formula: τ_max = √[(σ_avg/2)² + τ_avg²]. It does not ignore the normal stress contribution, using σ_avg = 6.25 MPa and τ_avg = 2.5 MPa to compute τ_max ≈ 4.00 MPa. This matches the ground truth approach.
